structure: Washington 2019 K-12 Social Studies Learning Standards (Word master). Front matter (license, adoption statement, introduction, numbering key, learning goals) then three grade-band parts: Elementary (K-5), Middle School (6-8), High School (9-12), each opening with discipline overview narratives and the five overarching learning standards (Social Studies Skills, Civics, Economics, Geography, History). Then one block per performance standard (SSS1-4 skills; C1-4 civics; E1-4 economics; G1-3 geography; H1-4 history), repeated per band: heading line 'C1: ...', 'Enduring Understanding' + text, a 2-column table (Components | Sample Questions) with ONE standards cell and ONE sample-questions cell, then 'Since Time Immemorial Connections' lines (Pathways lines, Washington State History/US History unit lines, Middle/High School curriculum lines, Native Knowledge 360 inquiries). Standard codes are DISCIPLINE+PERFORMANCE.GRADE.COMPONENT, e.g. C1.K.1, E2.3.4, H1.6-8.2, SSS1.9-12.3, C1.11-12.1, C2.9-10.1. Elementary tables are split into a K-2 table and a 3-5 table, each standards cell holding 'By the end of Kindergarten/1st/2nd grade, students will: ...' (or 3rd/4th/5th) for all grades of the band in a single unit; middle school cells hold (World) 6th, (WA) 7th, (US) 8th together (6-8); high school cells hold 9/10th and 11/12th together (9-12) except skills (9-12 only). Back matter: closing statement, FAQs, bibliography, acknowledgments, OSPI contact.
